items.methodology: Replay the scenario's declared agentic trace mix at concurrency 1; measured per-turn TTFT/TPOT/E2EL and throughput must meet these values. Latencies stop at p95 — the data source publishes no p99 for these families — and client-side tool execution is excluded.
